descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S02 Nursing Home: a clean resident list adds every resident, Follow-up, no invented MRN

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 A screenshot or photo of a patient list, sent for capture, adds the patients to the list automatically via OCR, with no manual re-typing. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 2; TFA-92580 How it works 2-3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U6 New patients get a Follow-up badge: scanned ones (including the new ones from a day-2 scan) and manually added ones. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 4; TFA-92580 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U7 A scan never invents an MRN, room or name. A field the photo did not have is left blank and flagged. (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 6; TFA-92580 How it works 5; UAT 3.4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given Fresh physician on the local stack; the fixture resident is in Today's Visits

When Switch to Nursing Home → Scan resident list → upload n-day1-clean.png → add all rows to Today's Visits

Then All 3 residents are in Today's Visits and All Residents, at Follow-up. The list has no MRN column, so no MRN value appears for them. The fixture resident is still in All Residents

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs on the checkpoints. An 'SNF-' prefix anywhere for these residents is an invented MRN (U7). Whether the blank MRN is 'flagged' is judged by a person from the screenshot until Q2 is answered. Whether the fixture resident should stay in Today's Visits is Q6, recorded but not judged. No re-typing is checked from the session log, as in S01

Where it ran: dev; test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (real image, real scan path)); secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
